id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

actionMap.description:
A map of data IDs to actions that can be used to fetch the data.

Can be used with {@link #contextVars} to substitute dynamic values. Use `${contextVarName}` to
use the context var in the args of the action. These `contextVars` do not always refresh automatically unlike
the `contextVars` of UiSdl Components. For automatic refresh, this must be used with page params and the
`UseUiApDataStore` hook.

See {@link #contextVars} for more details.

resolvedActionMap.description:
A map of data IDs to the resolved action that can be used to fetch the data.
Consists of the {@link #actionMap} with the context vars resolved.

dataMap.description: A map of data IDs to the data that has been fetched.

contextVars.description:
These context vars will be automatically resolved for variables that use page params or depend on this data store's state.
Otherwise, the context vars will not be resolved automatically.

When the context vars are resolved, the data will be refetched automatically for any action that does not
have `doNotAutoRequest` set to true.

resolvedContextVars.description:
A map of the resolved #contextVars, where the `key`s are the same as #contextVars but the `value` is the extracted
value from {@link UiSdlDynamicValueSpecParam}.

isLoadingMap.description: A map of data IDs to a boolean indicating if the data is currently being fetched.

redirectTo.description: The URL to redirect to when the user exits the model scenario.

jobName.description:
The name to be used for the scenario process job.

@see ReliabilityOrchestrator.ModelScenarioProcess.Spec#name

lookbackDuration.description:
Holds the {@link ReliabilityMlModel#pipeline} `lookbackDuration` in seconds format.
Used to calculate the data window from the scenario window.

```
Scenario Window = [Start, End]
Data Window = [Start - lookbackDuration, End]
```

@see ReliabilityMl.Pipeline

asset.description:
The {@link ReliabilityAsset} that is associated with the {@link ReliabilityMlModel} the
scenario is based on.

facility.description: The {@link Facility} that is associated from the #asset that the {@link ReliabilityMlModel} belongs to.

dataInterval.description: The {@link Interval} the {@link ReliabilityMlModel#datasetPreparationRun} is configured to use.

selectedItems.description: The array of {@link Feature}s that are plotted in the chart.

scenarioWindowAtCSVUpload.description:
This field captures the original time window that was selected by the user when they
uploaded CSV data containing feature overrides. It serves as a reference point for
comparison and restoration purposes.

**Data Format:**
Array containing two {@link DateTime} values: `[startDate, endDate]`

lastPlottedTimeRange.description:
The most recent {@link TimeRange} used to request chart data.
It serves as a reference point for request optimization purposes.

title: Application state that holds the model scenario information.
name: ModelScenarioApplicationState
